projects.name: Loyalty & Rewards API
projects.description: Backend API for a multi-brand loyalty app with points, wallets, redemptions, and admin tooling. Built with Node.js, TypeScript, Express, and PostgreSQL and deployed for mobile and admin clients.

projects.name: Stock Trading (Social Fintech) Backend
projects.description: Backend API for a stock-trading and community fintech platform covering auth, onboarding, KYC, portfolio, and social feeds. Built with Node.js, TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL, and Docker, with JWT, Zod validation, and performance optimizations.

projects.name: Apply-Kit
projects.description: Private job search CRM for dual-lane applications (backend + applied AI). Syncs profile data from Epic Node, archives job descriptions, matches JD keywords, generates tailored intros, and tracks follow-ups via Node.js CLI.
